title: Primary living space on the ground floor has direct access to the primary garden area
text: C2.1.1 Each dwelling is to have one room that is the designated primary living space where: i. the primary living space is provided on the ground floor, it is to have direct physical and visual access to the primary garden area; or

replaces.note: new deemed exempt provision for grouped dwellings R2-R25 (Part B had none; OLA accessible from the primary living space)
Part C text carried into Chapter 3

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Tests access to the primary garden area, which in Chapter 3 exists only at R30 and above; R25 and below use the outdoor living area (C1.1.1), so whether this binds R25 and below is unclear (register ch3-020). Encoded for all codes as printed, as in Chapter 2. Verify scope.

verified.note: Values and wording match p15. Ambiguous on the page: the clause carries no density qualifier but tests access to the primary garden area, which Chapter 3 uses at R30 and above; whether it binds R25 and below (where the outdoor living area applies) is not stated.
